plugins.name: firecrawl
plugins.description: Scrape, search, crawl, and map the web with a single command.

skills.name: firecrawl-agent
skills.description: Autonomous multi-page extraction into structured JSON. Use when the user wants website data matching a schema — pricing tiers, product listings — beyond a single-page scrape.
headings: With a JSON schema for structured output
Wait on an existing job, polling every 10 seconds for up to 5 minutes
skills.description_zh: 自主从多个网页提取符合模式的结构化 JSON，用于价格档位、产品列表等超出单页抓取的网站数据。

skills.name: firecrawl-crawl
skills.description: Bulk-extract many pages from one site or section. Use for "crawl", "everything under /docs", or content spanning linked pages.
headings: Check status of a running crawl
skills.description_zh: 批量提取同一网站或目录下互相链接的多页内容，适用于整站抓取或 /docs 等区段采集。

skills.name: firecrawl-developer-index
skills.description: Search issues, merged pull requests, READMEs, and documentation. Use when the question is how a library or API behaves, what an error means, or whether a bug was fixed; prefer this over a general web page.
headings: The tools, and what each is uniquely good at
Filters, and what each one costs you
Match the approach to the question
skills.description_zh: 检索问题、已合并 PR、README 和文档，回答库或 API 行为、错误含义及缺陷是否修复，原文建议优先于一般网页来源。

skills.name: firecrawl-download
skills.description: Save a site or section as local files (markdown, screenshots). Use for "download the site", offline docs, or a local copy for reference.
headings: Multiple formats (each saved as its own file per page)
Creates per page: index.md + links.txt + screenshot.png
skills.description_zh: 将网站或区段保存为本地 Markdown、截图等文件，用于离线文档和参考副本。

skills.name: firecrawl-interact
skills.description: Drive a live browser on a scraped page: click, fill forms, log in, paginate, infinite-scroll. Use when content requires interaction or a scrape failed or returned incomplete content.
headings: 1. Scrape a page (scrape ID is saved automatically)
2. Interact with the page using a positional prompt
A UUID first argument is auto-detected as the scrape ID
3. Or use code for precise control
skills.description_zh: 在抓取页面的实时浏览器中点击、填表、登录、翻页和无限滚动，用于必须交互才能读取内容或抓取失败、内容不完整的页面。

skills.name: firecrawl-map
skills.description: Discover and list a site's URLs, with search filtering. Use for "map the site" or "find the URL for" requests — when the user knows the site but not the exact page, or wants site structure.
headings: Find a specific page on a large site
skills.description_zh: 发现和列出网站 URL 并按搜索条件过滤，用于已知网站但不知具体页面、查找某页地址或了解站点结构。

skills.name: firecrawl-monitor
skills.description: Alert by webhook/email on web changes — use for "monitor/watch/track/alert me when": recurring checks on known URLs (prefer over repeated one-off scrapes) or web-wide watches for new results (queries + goal).
headings: Single page, natural-language schedule, email alert
Web monitor — search the whole web for NEW results matching a goal
skills.description_zh: 定期检查已知 URL 的网页变化，或按查询与目标监控全网新结果，再通过 webhook 或邮件告警；原文建议用持续监控替代重复单次抓取。

skills.name: firecrawl-parse
skills.description: Convert a local file (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, HTML, …) to markdown, or answer questions about its content. Use whenever the input is a file path, not a URL.
headings: Ask a question about the doc
skills.description_zh: 将本地 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、HTML 等文件转换为 Markdown，或回答其内容问题；适用于输入为文件路径的场景。

skills.name: firecrawl-research-index
skills.description: Find the papers that answer a research query in Firecrawl's research paper index — a corpus of paper abstracts whose largest share is biomedical and life-science literature (PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv), alongside arXiv preprints in CS, physics, and math — using semantic search, semantic and structural expansion, and in-body verification. Use this skill for literature-finding and paper-retrieval tasks of any kind, including clinical, biomedical, drug, gene, disease, and other life-science questions, whether the answer is a single paper or a full multi-paper set. The index is reached only through the `firecrawl_research_*` MCP tools or the `firecrawl research` CLI subcommands. Calling `firecrawl_search` with its `categories` option set to `["research"]` is a different feature — it filters ordinary web search to research-affiliated websites (the list includes PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv, and publisher sites) and returns page results from them, without querying the paper records in this index.
headings: The tools, and what each is uniquely good at
Match the approach to the query
skills.description_zh: 通过 Firecrawl 论文索引的语义搜索、语义/结构扩展和正文验证查找论文，覆盖以生物医学和生命科学为主的 PubMed、bioRxiv、medRxiv，以及 arXiv 计算机、物理和数学预印本；该索引仅由 research MCP/CLI 访问，与普通网页搜索 research 分类不同。

skills.name: firecrawl-scrape
skills.description: Extract a URL's content as clean markdown, including JS-rendered pages. Use whenever the user provides a URL and wants its content; prefer over WebFetch.
headings: Wait for JS to render, then scrape
Multiple URLs (markdown only; each saved to .firecrawl/; -o is ignored)
Ask a question about the page
skills.description_zh: 将给定 URL 内容提取为干净 Markdown，包括 JavaScript 渲染页面，原文建议用于用户给出网址并需要正文时。

skills.name: firecrawl-search
skills.description: Web search with full page content. Use when no URL is known: finding sources, articles, or news. For papers use firecrawl-research-index; for library, API, error, or bug questions use firecrawl-developer-index.
headings: Search and scrape full page content from results
Send feedback after every search (refunds 1 credit)
Send once per search. Rate honestly and replace the placeholder with the
rating that matches what actually happened. The two fields shown
satisfy the substantive-content rule for every rating.
skills.description_zh: 在未知 URL 时进行带完整页面内容的网页搜索，寻找来源、文章或新闻；论文和库/API/错误/缺陷问题分别交由研究与开发者索引技能。

skills.name: firecrawl
skills.description: Any live-web task via the Firecrawl CLI — including ordinary web research: searching the web, reading or extracting pages, gathering sources, discovering site URLs, bulk extraction, downloading a site, change alerts, or pages needing clicks/login — web only; local files route to firecrawl-parse. For papers use firecrawl-research-index; for library, API, error, or bug questions use firecrawl-developer-index.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Firecrawl CLI 执行网页搜索、读取提取、来源整理、URL 发现、批量抓取、站点下载、变更提醒及需要点击登录的网页任务；本地文件、论文和开发者问题分别路由到专用技能。
